crossRefs.note: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all…
The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of…
He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on…
He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense…

translations.web: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
translations.bsb: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
translations.asv: and the priest shall take a handful of the meal-offering, as the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
